mechanism_narrative: A strong growth in GDP indicates a robust economy, which in turn drives up demand for goods and services, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances despite strong GDP growth, or GDP growth is not significantly correlated with SPX returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 5% signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 50% of instances despite high FEDFUNDS, or FEDFUNDS is not significantly correlated with SPX returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4% indicates a strong labor market, which in turn drives up consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of instances despite low UNRATE, or UNRATE is not significantly correlated with SPX returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production indicates a strong supply chain, which in turn drives up economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of instances despite strong INDPRO growth, or INDPRO is not significantly correlated with SPX returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in GDP and consumer spending indicates a strong economy, which in turn drives up demand for goods and services, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of instances despite strong GDP and RSAFS growth, or the joint effect of GDP and RSAFS is not significantly correlated with SPX returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate below 4% and a simultaneous increase in the money supply indicates an easing monetary cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of instances despite low FEDFUNDS and high RSAFS, or the joint effect of FEDFUNDS and RSAFS is not significantly correlated with SPX returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong growth in payroll employment indicates a robust labor market, which in turn drives up consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances despite strong PAYEMS growth, or PAYEMS is not significantly correlated with SPX returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts and consumer spending indicates a strong economy, which in turn drives up demand for goods and services, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of instances despite strong HOUST and RSAFS growth, or the joint effect of HOUST and RSAFS is not significantly correlated with SPX returns (p > 0.05).
